title: Mathematics
description: The foundation of all ML/AI: linear algebra, calculus, probability, and statistics.

resources.title: Essence of Linear Algebra | 3Blue1Brown
resources.author: 3Blue1Brown
resources.description: Stunning visual intuitions for vectors, matrices, and transformations. The best starting point.

resources.title: Linear Algebra | Gilbert Strang (MIT 18.06)
resources.author: Gilbert Strang
resources.description: The gold standard linear algebra course. Strang's intuitive style makes even abstract concepts click.

resources.title: Immersive Linear Algebra
resources.author: J. Ström, K. Åström, T. Akenine-Möller
resources.description: The world's first linear algebra book with fully interactive figures. Covers vectors, matrices, and transformations.

resources.title: Linear Algebra Done Right
resources.author: Sheldon Axler
resources.description: A rigorous, proof-based approach to linear algebra emphasizing structure over computation. Free online.

resources.title: Calculus | Gilbert Strang (MIT 18.01 & 18.02)
resources.author: Gilbert Strang
resources.description: Single and multivariable calculus from MIT OpenCourseWare. Essential for understanding gradients and optimization.

resources.title: Essence of Calculus | 3Blue1Brown
resources.author: 3Blue1Brown
resources.description: Visual series rebuilding calculus intuition from scratch: derivatives, integrals, and the chain rule.

resources.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning (Book)
resources.author: Marc Peter Deisenroth, A. Aldo Faisal, Cheng Soon Ong
resources.description: A comprehensive book covering the mathematical foundations needed for ML, freely available online.

resources.title: Statistics and Probability | Khan Academy
resources.author: Khan Academy
resources.description: Friendly, interactive statistics and probability course covering all key concepts for ML.

resources.title: Introduction to Probability (MIT 6.041)
resources.author: John Tsitsiklis
resources.description: Rigorous probability theory with applications. Covers random variables, distributions, and inference.

resources.title: The Matrix Calculus You Need For Deep Learning
resources.author: Terence Parr & Jeremy Howard
resources.description: A concise, practical guide to the matrix calculus operations used in neural network backpropagation.

resources.title: Computational Linear Algebra | fast.ai
resources.author: Rachel Thomas
resources.description: Practical numerical linear algebra with Python, covering SVD, NMF, topic modeling, and randomized algorithms.

resources.title: Statistical Rethinking
resources.author: Richard McElreath
resources.description: A Bayesian statistics course using causal inference. Accompanying lectures are freely available on YouTube.

resources.title: Convex Optimization | Boyd & Vandenberghe (Stanford)
resources.author: Stephen Boyd
resources.description: The definitive textbook on convex optimization, foundational for understanding ML training objectives.

resources.title: Numerical Methods for Scientists and Engineers
resources.author: Hamming
resources.description: Classic text on numerical analysis covering root finding, integration, ODEs, and Fourier methods.

resources.title: Probability Theory: The Logic of Science
resources.author: E. T. Jaynes
resources.description: A deep Bayesian treatment of probability theory as an extension of logic. Influential in ML research.
